title: Pokémon Scarlet & Violet 151 Bulk Cards – Approx. 800+ Cards
description:
Large bulk lot of Pokémon cards from the Scarlet & Violet 151 set.

Approximately 800+ cards across the two storage boxes pictured.

Good mix of Pokémon and Trainer cards with plenty of duplicates, making this a great lot for anyone collecting the 151 set, building decks, filling binders or adding to their collection.

Cards are in good condition and have been stored safely in boxes.

Both boxes and all cards pictured are included.

Please check photos as they form part of the description.
